{{Top|leg}}
'''Assistant Auditor-General''' was a title given to a high ranking official in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] who worked as one the assistants to the [[Auditor-General]]. Their primary responsibilities were confirm information that was sent to the Auditor-General's office and investigate suspicious activity. This office also oversees the security division of the CSA. [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla]] was given this title only three years after joining the law enforcement arm of the CSA.
